$:set -euo pipefail
printf 'CURRENT_HEAD '; git rev-parse HEAD
if test -f README.md; then cat README.md >/dev/null; else echo 'NO_ROOT_README'; fi
test -f AGENTS.md && cat AGENTS.md >/dev/null
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/issues/3 --jq .body >/dev/null
target='.devcontainer/devcontainer.json'
test -f "$target" && test ! -L "$target"
if test -f config/file-metadata.json; then echo 'STOP_METADATA_REGISTRY_PRESENT'; exit 42; fi
printf 'TARGET_BEFORE\n'; git ls-files -- "$target"; cat "$target"
git rm -- "$target"
git diff --cached --check
gh auth setup-git
git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
git commit -m 'Remove unrequested Codespaces devcontainer configuration'
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
 git fetch origin main -q
 git rebase origin/main -q
 if git push origin HEAD:main; then break; fi
 test "$i" -lt 4
done
printf 'PUBLISHED_COMMIT '; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'TARGET_AFTER '; if test -e "$target"; then echo 'STILL_EXISTS'; exit 44; else echo 'ABSENT'; fi
printf 'CHANGED_FILES\n'; git show --format= --name-status HEAD
printf 'REMOTE_CHECK\n'; if gh api 'repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json?ref=main' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'REMOTE_STILL_EXISTS'; exit 45; else echo 'REMOTE_NOT_FOUND'; fi
